lines.en: label kirininvite1:
I tap on Kirin’s name in my phone and wait for her to answer.
lines.zh: 我在手机上点了一下 Kirin 的名字，等她接。

lines.en: Whenever the two of us hang out, it’s usually something along the lines of me going over to {i}her{/i} part of town and just...killing time however {i}she{/i} wants to that day.
lines.zh: 我们俩平时一起玩，基本都是我跑到{i}她{/i}那片城区，然后……按{i}她{/i}当天的心情随便消磨时间。

lines.en: But I feel like we’ve gotten close enough at this point that she’d be willing to hang out at my place instead.
lines.zh: 但我觉得我们到现在已经够熟了，她应该也愿意改来我家玩。

lines.en: Now, knowing Kirin, it’s highly possible that she’s been waiting for me to invite her over this entire time-
lines.zh: 不过，以 Kirin 的性格，她很可能从一开始就在等我开口邀她过来——

lines.en: But it’s not exactly easy finding an opportunity to bring over a girl from another class, and there’s no way Ami wouldn’t be suspicious of that if she caught it happening.
lines.zh: 但要把别班的女生带回家，机会实在不好找，而且要是被 Ami 撞见，她不可能不起疑心。

lines.en: As such, today might be the only chance I have for a while to actually follow through with the idea, as her and some of the others are going shopping in the urban district of Kumon-mi.
lines.zh: 正因如此，今天大概是接下来好一阵子里我唯一能把这个念头付诸实践的机会，因为她和其他几个人要去 Kumon-mi 的市区逛街。

lines.en: : Hey~ Whatcha up to?
lines.zh: : 嘿~ 在干嘛呢？

lines.en: : Heading back to my place. You?
lines.zh: : 正准备回我家。你呢？

lines.en: : What a coincidence. I’m {i}also{/i} heading back to my place.
lines.zh: : 好巧。我{i}也{/i}正准备回我家。

lines.en: : Wow. Maybe this is some sort of sign?
lines.zh: : 哇。说不定这是某种征兆？

lines.en: : Maybe it is! Are you suggesting we hang out?
lines.zh: : 说不定就是呢！你是在提议我们出去玩吗？

lines.en: : I suppose I might be. Do you have any objections to coming over my place this time?
lines.zh: : 也许吧。这次改来我家，你有没有意见？

lines.en: : Uhh...where do you even live?
lines.zh: : 呃……你到底住哪儿啊？

lines.en: : Do you know where Ayane lives?
lines.zh: : 你知道 Ayane 家在哪儿吗？

lines.en: : Yeah. You’re over there?
lines.zh: : 知道。你住那边？

lines.en: : No. Nowhere near it, actually.
lines.zh: : 不。其实离得远着呢。

lines.en: : ...Then why would you even bring that up?
lines.zh: : ……那你提这个干嘛？

lines.en: : I’ll just text you the address. You can make it in less than an hour coming from your apartment.
lines.zh: : 我直接把地址发给你吧。从你公寓过来不到一小时就能到。

lines.en: : You’ve been traveling that far just to meet up with me this whole time?
lines.zh: : 这段时间以来你一直跑那么远，就为了见我？

lines.en: : Yeah. I’m so kind, aren’t I?
lines.zh: : 是啊。我是不是很贴心？

lines.en: : That or you just really like walking.
lines.zh: : 或者说你只是真的很爱走路。

lines.en: : Is Ami home right now? Or is this the same kind of secret meeting we have when you come over my place?
lines.zh: : Ami 现在在家吗？还是说这又是你来我家时的那种秘密会面？

lines.en: : I would absolutely not invite you over if Ami was there.
lines.zh: : 如果 Ami 在，我绝对不会叫你过来。

lines.en: : Ouch.
lines.zh: : 扎心了。

lines.en: : But yeah, text me the address. I’ll head over now.
lines.zh: : 不过好吧，把地址发我。我现在就过去。

lines.en: : We’re ordering food, though. I’m starving.
lines.zh: : 不过我们得叫外卖。我快饿死了。

lines.en: : Deal.
lines.zh: : 成交。

lines.en: : Sweet. See you soon, [kirinmaster]~
lines.zh: : 好耶。一会儿见，[kirinmaster]~

lines.en: The call comes to an end and I immediately send Kirin my address.
lines.zh: 电话挂断，我立刻把地址发给了 Kirin。

lines.en: She doesn’t respond, but I guess there’s not really any reason to, considering a street name and some numbers aren’t a great start to a conversation.
lines.zh: 她没有回复，不过我想也没什么好回的，毕竟一条街名加几个数字实在算不上一场对话的好开头。

lines.en: scene black
The walk back is a cold one. The wind is out in full force today.
lines.zh: 回去的路上很冷。今天风刮得正猛。

lines.en: I feel kind of bad for making Kirin bear this all the way over, but one of us was going to wind up suffering through it no matter what.
lines.zh: 让 Kirin 一路顶着风过来，我有点过意不去，但不管怎样，我们俩总有一个要遭这份罪。

lines.en: I’ll just make it up to her by buying her dinner whenever we decide on something to order.
lines.zh: 等我们决定好点什么，我就买晚餐请她，算是补偿吧。

lines.en: scene kirinfirstinvite1
: Thanks for having me~
lines.zh: : 谢谢收留我~

lines.en: Kirin lets herself in once I give her the okay and slides her boots off at the door before gleefully trotting up to me.
lines.zh: 我说了声请进，Kirin 便自己开了门，在门口把靴子一脱，欢快地小跑着凑到我跟前。

lines.en: : Your cheeks are bright red. You’re not nervous about being alone in my house, are you?
lines.zh: : 你脸颊通红。该不会是因为单独和我待在家里紧张吧？

lines.en: : No. I’m just freezing cold since I walked all the way over here on the windiest day ever.
lines.zh: : 不是。我只是冷得要死，因为在有史以来风最大的这天一路走过来的。

lines.en: : I basically had to hold my skirt down the entire way so it wouldn’t blow up and give everybody a peek at my underwear.
lines.zh: : 我基本上得一路按住裙子，免得它被吹起来让所有人都看到我的内裤。

lines.en: : They're black, in case you were wondering.
lines.zh: : 是黑色的，万一你想知道的话。

lines.en: Jokes on you, Kirin. I'm {i}always{/i} wondering.
lines.zh: 你失算了，Kirin。我可是{i}一直{/i}都在想。

lines.en: : That’s basically the exact opposite of what you did when you came into my office for the first time.
lines.zh: : 这跟你第一次进我办公室时的表现基本完全相反。

lines.en: : Ooooh, I remember that. When I showed you my panties and you didn’t even get hard.
lines.zh: : 哦哦哦，我记得。我给你看内裤，你连硬都没硬。

lines.en: : I think I did. But it was a pretty confusing meeting and I don’t remember much of it other than that you owe me your virginity now.
lines.zh: : 我觉得硬了吧。不过那次会面太莫名其妙了，除了你现在欠我处女这件事，我别的都不太记得了。

lines.en: scene kirinfirstinvite2
: Oh, about that.
lines.zh: : 哦，关于那个。

lines.en: : Do you think there will be a lot of blood? I’m not really sure what to expect.
lines.zh: : 你觉得会流很多血吗？我真不知道该有心理准备。

lines.en: : Just look it up online. I don’t want to talk about the amount of blood that will come out of you.
lines.zh: : 上网查去。我可不想讨论会从你身体里流出多少血。

lines.en: : I tried, but I keep getting different answers and I figured it would be better to ask you since you’ve definitely taken a few v-cards by now.
lines.zh: : 我查了，可答案五花八门，我觉得还是问你比较好，毕竟你到现在肯定已经收过好几张处女卡了。

lines.en: : You’re wasting no time in getting into the accusations today.
lines.zh: : 你今天倒是毫不浪费时间地开始指控我了。

lines.en: scene kirinfirstinvite3
: Heheh~ I know you’ve stolen at least {i}one{/i}. But, for all I know, you could be screwing half of the soccer team by now.
lines.zh: : 嘿嘿~ 我知道你至少偷过{i}一张{/i}。不过，就我所知，你现在说不定已经把半个足球队都睡遍了。

lines.en: : There’s no way I’d be able to do that without you finding out about it.
lines.zh: : 我要真那样干，不可能不让你发现。

lines.en: : Yeah, I think it’s fair to assume that I’ll figure out pretty much everything you do sooner or later, so you should just be open and honest with me.
lines.zh: : 是啊，我觉得可以公平地假设，你做的几乎每件事我迟早都会弄清楚，所以你不如对我坦白点。

lines.en: : That’s more fun anyway, right?
lines.zh: : 那样更有意思，对吧？

lines.en: : In that case, let me start this “open and honest” meeting by saying you look very cute today.
lines.zh: : 既然如此，那就让我用一句“你今天真可爱”来开启这场开诚布公的会面吧。

lines.en: scene kirinfirstinvite4
: Thanks! But, just so you remember, I’m not blushing and my cheeks are only red from the cold.
lines.zh: : 谢谢！不过你记着，我没有脸红，脸红只是冻的。

lines.en: : I {i}know{/i} I look extra cute today, though, so I’m glad you’re being honest with me.
lines.zh: : 但我{i}知道{/i}自己今天格外可爱，所以我很高兴你对我说了实话。

lines.en: : As repayment, I’ll say one honest thing to you as well.
lines.zh: : 作为回礼，我也对你说一句实话。

lines.en: scene kirinfirstinvite5
: I’m lowkey really fucking nervous about losing my virginity today.
lines.zh: : 我其实他妈超级紧张今天会失去处女之身。

lines.en: : Like, I was fine with it when you called me.
lines.zh: : 就是，你打电话的时候我还好好的。

lines.en: : But the walk over here was so long that it gave me way too much time to think and now I can’t tell if my hands are shaking from the cold or from my nerves.
lines.zh: : 但走过来的路太长了，给了我想太多的时间，现在我分不清手是冻得发抖还是紧张得发抖。

lines.en: : Well, that’s significantly more open and honest than I was.
lines.zh: : 嗯，这可比我坦诚多了。

lines.en: scene kirinfirstinvite6
: Hahahaha...yeaaaaaah...
lines.zh: : 哈哈哈哈……是————啊……

lines.en: : Also, I didn’t have time to shave since I came directly from the convenience store and that’s making me self-conscious too.
lines.zh: : 还有，我从便利店直接过来，没时间刮毛，这也让我很不自在。

lines.en: : So like, you can still totally do me some other time buuuuuut I’m kind of scared as fuck right now.
lines.zh: : 所以，那个，你完全可以改天再对我做，但……但我现在真的怕得要死。

lines.en: : Just too much all at once, I guess.
lines.zh: : 大概就是一下子太多了吧。

lines.en: scene kirinfirstinvite7
: But, uhh...now that {i}that’s{/i} out of the way, what did you want to eat for dinner?
lines.zh: : 不过，呃……{i}既然话都说开了{/i}，你晚饭想吃什么？

lines.en: : I was thinking we could just order from a bunch of different places and then split whatever the cost is.
lines.zh: : 我在想我们可以从好几家不同的店各点一些，然后平分账单。

lines.en: : That jump between subjects was incredibly jarring based on everything I just learned.
lines.zh: : 考虑到我刚听到的一切，这个话题转变得实在太生硬了。

lines.en: : I was just repaying your honesty with my own honesty. Don’t think it was some huge breakthrough or anything.
lines.zh: : 我只是用我的坦诚来回报你的坦诚。别以为那是什么重大突破之类的。

lines.en: : The {i}real{/i} breakthrough will be when you tear through my hymen and cause an undisclosed amount of blood to come pouring out of me.
lines.zh: : {i}真正的{/i}突破，是你撕开我的处女膜，让不知多少血从我身体里涌出来的那一刻。

lines.en: : So, about dinner-
lines.zh: : 所以，关于晚饭——

lines.en: scene kirinfirstinvite8
: This is really awkward.
lines.zh: : 这真是太尴尬了。

lines.en: : It is, but I’m definitely not taking the blame for it this time.
lines.zh: : 是挺尴尬，但这次我绝对不背这个锅。

lines.en: : I know. I’m clearly less prepared than I thought I’d be for something like this.
lines.zh: : 我知道。我对这种事的准备，显然没有自己以为的那么充分。

lines.en: : So, dinner.
lines.zh: : 所以，晚饭。

lines.en: : Right, dinner.
lines.zh: : 对，晚饭。

lines.en: scene black
Well, that was not exactly the start to this visit that I was expecting.
lines.zh: 嗯，这趟来访的开场可真不是我预想的样子。

lines.en: It was...nice seeing Kirin be honest about something that wasn’t entirely malicious or confusing for once, though.
lines.zh: 不过……看到 Kirin 终于坦诚了一件不完全是恶意、也不让人摸不着头脑的事，还挺好的。

lines.en: It’s probably the first thing I’ve seen her do that I can actually say I understand.
lines.zh: 这大概是她做过的事里，第一件我敢说我看懂了的。

lines.en: Opening up about your fears isn’t an easy thing to do, which is likely why she used my compliment as a crutch to piggyback off of.
lines.zh: 把自己的恐惧说出口不是件容易的事，所以她大概是把我的夸奖当成了拐杖，顺着往上爬。

lines.en: Within minutes of arriving here, she felt threatened and took a defensive stance.
lines.zh: 到这里不过几分钟，她就感到了威胁，摆出了防御姿态。

lines.en: And, when you’re around someone like me, or whatever her vision of me is, there’s no harm in taking a few extra precautions.
lines.zh: 而在我这种人身边——或者说在她想象中的我这种人身边——多防着点也没什么坏处。

lines.en: The two of us proceed to flip through a number of takeout menus that Ami and I keep on top of the microwave, ordering from a grand total of four of them.
lines.zh: 我们俩接着翻起微波炉顶上我和 Ami 存的一堆外卖菜单，最后总共从四家店点了餐。

lines.en: I don’t take Kirin up on her offer to split the bill and decide to pay for everything myself, figuring I can keep any leftovers and just...eat them throughout the week.
lines.zh: 我没有接受 Kirin 平分账单的提议，决定自己全付，想着剩菜可以留着……这周慢慢吃。

lines.en: And, within forty-five minutes or so, our feast is finally ready to begin.
lines.zh: 大约四十五分钟后，我们的盛宴终于可以开动了。

lines.en: scene kirinfirstinvite9
: So, uhh...That was kind of weird before, right?
lines.zh: : 那个，呃……刚才有点奇怪，对吧？

lines.en: : I mean, {i}me{/i} being the one to say all that stuff about getting nervous when I’ve done nothing but try and get into your pants since I met you.
lines.zh: : 我是说，我从认识你起就一门心思只想扒了你的裤子，结果现在反倒是{i}我{/i}说出那些紧张的话。

lines.en: : What was that all about, right? Hahaha...
lines.zh: : 这算什么事儿啊，对吧？哈哈哈哈……

lines.en: : You really don’t have to keep bringing this up, Kirin. We can just eat now.
lines.zh: : 你真的不用一直提这个了，Kirin。我们现在就吃饭吧。

lines.en: scene kirinfirstinvite10
: Ahhhhh I know that!
lines.zh: : 啊啊啊啊我知道啦！

lines.en: : I just feel so immature all of a sudden and I don’t like it.
lines.zh: : 我只是突然觉得自己好幼稚，我不喜欢这样。

lines.en: : Can’t you just come out and admit something equally embarrassing so I can get over this?
lines.zh: : 你就不能也说点同样丢人的事，好让我翻篇吗？

lines.en: : I...can’t really think of anything that embarrassing, to be honest.
lines.zh: : 说实话……我真想不出什么丢人的事。

lines.en: : What, you never like, walked in on your parents having sex when you were little or something?
lines.zh: : 什么，你小时候就没撞见过父母做爱之类的？

lines.en: : Not that I can remember.
lines.zh: : 我不记得有。

lines.en: I can’t even remember what my parents looked like...
lines.zh: 我甚至连父母长什么样都记不清了……

lines.en: : Nothing with your [niece], either?
lines.zh: : 和你[niece]之间也没有？

lines.en: : You guys live together so like...she’s probably caught you jerking it or something before, right?
lines.zh: : 你们住在一起，所以……她大概撞见过你打飞机什么的吧？

lines.en: : Surprisingly, no.
lines.zh: : 意外的是，没有。

lines.en: scene kirinfirstinvite11
: Jesus, how boring is your life?
lines.zh: : 天哪，你的人生是有多无聊？

lines.en: : How have you not done {i}anything{/i} embarrassing when there are over ten hormonal [teenager]s watching you at all times?
lines.zh: : 有十几个荷尔蒙过剩的[teenager]时刻盯着你，你怎么可能没干过{i}什么丢人的事{/i}？

lines.en: : Myself included.
lines.zh: : 包括我。

lines.en: : Don’t think I’m quitting the game just because I got nervous and said some stuff I was thinking earlier.
lines.zh: : 别以为我因为紧张、说了些刚才想到的东西，就退出这场游戏了。

lines.en: : I still want you to go to fucking town on me eventually.
lines.zh: : 我迟早还是要你在我身上他妈大干一场的。

lines.en: : I’m glad to see you’re back to normal, Kirin.
lines.zh: : 很高兴看到你恢复正常了，Kirin。

lines.en: scene kirinfirstinvite12
: Yeah, I’m pretty sure I just needed sugar or something.
lines.zh: : 是啊，我大概只是需要点糖什么的。

lines.en: : I’m feeling a lot better now and I’m literally like two inches away from you.
lines.zh: : 我现在感觉好多了，而且我现在离你就两英寸远。

lines.en: scene kirinfirstinvite13
: Do you want a blowjob after we’re done eating?
lines.zh: : 吃完饭你想让我给你口交吗？

lines.en: : That’s gotta be worth dinner and those five minutes of counseling I needed earlier, right?
lines.zh: : 那总该值一顿晚饭，外加刚才我需要的那五分钟心理咨询吧？

lines.en: : Not if you’re going to make it sound like I’m extorting you.
lines.zh: : 如果你非要说得像我在敲诈你，那就不值了。

lines.en: scene kirinfirstinvite14
: So...first you turn down my free handjob on the beach...and now you’re turning down my mouth?
lines.zh: : 所以……先是我给你的免费手交你在海滩上拒绝了……现在连我的嘴你也要拒绝？

lines.en: : You really {i}are{/i} gay, aren’t you?
lines.zh: : 你真的{i}是{/i} gay 吧？

lines.en: : I’m not gay...
lines.zh: : 我不是 gay……

lines.en: : Well then what’s the deal?
lines.zh: : 那到底是怎么回事？

lines.en: : Why are you pushing me away? What am I doing that’s so wrong?
lines.zh: : 你为什么要把我推开？我到底做错了什么？

lines.en: : I just...
lines.zh: : 我只是……

lines.en: scene kirinfirstinvite15
: Hah...
: I don’t offer these things just to get you to like me, Sensei.
lines.zh: : 我提这些，不只是为了让你喜欢我，老师。

lines.en: : I want to have fun with you and I want {i}you{/i} to {i}want{/i} to have fun with me.
lines.zh: : 我想和你一起玩，也想让{i}你{/i}{i}想{/i}和我一起玩。

lines.en: scene kirinfirstinvite16
: But I guess having you buy me dinner is enough fun for today.
lines.zh: : 不过，能让你请我吃顿晚饭，今天也算够开心了。

lines.en: : I’ll probably be too full afterward to suck you off anyway.
lines.zh: : 而且吃完我大概会太撑，也没法给你口交了。

lines.en: : And you know what they say about giving blowjobs on a full stomach.
lines.zh: : 你知道大家怎么说吃饱了肚子口交的。

lines.en: : I have no idea what they say about that.
lines.zh: : 我完全不知道大家怎么说那个。

lines.en: : Oh. Well, they probably say it’s bad or whatever.
lines.zh: : 哦。嗯，他们大概会说那样不好之类的。

lines.en: : I don’t know. I kind of just made that up hoping you wouldn't actually respond to it.
lines.zh: : 我不知道。我其实只是随口编的，指望你不会真的接话。

lines.en: scene kirinfirstinvite17
Our conversation is suddenly interrupted by what may just be the last sound effect I ever hear.
lines.zh: 我们的对话突然被一个声音打断，那可能是我这辈子听到的最后一个音效。

lines.en: : What was that noise just now?
lines.zh: : 刚才那是什么声音？

lines.en: : You heard that, right?
lines.zh: : 你听到了吧？

lines.en: : Either Ami is home way ahead of schedule or I am about to be robbed.
lines.zh: : 要么 Ami 提前回来了，要么我就要被打劫了。

lines.en: : Neither of those things are good for me.
lines.zh: : 这两种情况对我都没好处。

lines.en: : Which one of them do you think sounds good for {i}me{/i}?
lines.zh: : 你觉得哪一种对{i}我{/i}有好处？

lines.en: : The Ami one, obviously.
lines.zh: : 显然是 Ami 那一种。

lines.en: : It would probably be safer getting robbed than having to deal with the fallout of her finding us together.
lines.zh: : 被打劫大概都比被她发现我们在一起要安全。

lines.en: : Jesus. What kind of relationship do you two have?
lines.zh: : 天哪。你们俩到底是什么关系？

lines.en: : I’m home!
lines.zh: : 我回来了！

lines.en: : I’m going to die.
lines.zh: : 我要死了。

lines.en: scene kirinfirstinvite18
: No...you’re not.
lines.zh: : 不……你不会。

lines.en: : Do you have any idea how many times I’ve stealthily [masturbate]d in the same room as my sister, Sensei?
lines.zh: : 你知道我有多少次在姐姐同一个房间里偷偷[masturbate]过吗，老师？

lines.en: : I’ll show you how good I am at being undetected.
lines.zh: : 让你见识见识我有多擅长不被发现。

lines.en: : Watch.
lines.zh: : 看着。

lines.en: scene black
scene kirinfirstinvite19
: Umm...
: What’s...going on here?
lines.zh: : 那个……这是什么情况？

lines.en: : I was very hungry.
lines.zh: : 我非常饿。

lines.en: scene kirinfirstinvite20
: Don’t you think...this is a little much?
lines.zh: : 你不觉得……这也太多了点吗？

lines.en: : I thought Maya might be coming over when you got home.
lines.zh: : 我以为你回来的时候 Maya 可能也一起来了。

lines.en: scene kirinfirstinvite21
: Oh, okay. Then yeah, that makes sense.
lines.zh: : 哦，好吧。那确实说得通。

lines.en: : Why are you back so early? I thought you were going shopping.
lines.zh: : 你怎么这么早就回来了？我还以为你们去逛街了。

lines.en: scene kirinfirstinvite22
: We were going to but...it was just way too cold and none of us wanted to wait at the bus stop.
lines.zh: : 我们本来是要去的，但是……实在太冷了，谁都不想在公交站等。

lines.en: : So we all just decided to head back.
lines.zh: : 所以大家就都决定回来了。

lines.en: : Cool, cool.
lines.zh: : 好好好。

lines.en: : Oh, Sensei. I saw a nice pair of boots at the door. Did you buy those for me?
lines.zh: : 哦，老师。我在门口看到一双很漂亮的靴子。那是你买给我的吗？

lines.en: scene kirinfirstinvite23
: {i}For real? Those are my favorite boots.{/i}
lines.zh: : {i}真的？那可是我最喜欢的靴子。{/i}

lines.en: : Hm?
: Did you hear something just now?
lines.zh: : 你刚才听到什么声音了吗？

lines.en: : All I heard was the sound of my regret for not being able to wrap the boots I definitely bought you in time.
lines.zh: : 我只听到了后悔的声音——后悔没来得及把我确实给你买的那双靴子包好。

lines.en: : Do you...want me to go into my room so you can wrap them now?
lines.zh: : 你……要我进房间去，好让你现在包吗？

lines.en: scene black
Ami, bless her heart, is gullible enough to take the bait and disappears into her room for the next few minutes, giving Kirin enough time to flee the house.
lines.zh: Ami 这人心地善良，好骗到真的上了钩，接下来的几分钟里她消失在自己房间里，给 Kirin 争取到了足够的逃跑时间。

lines.en: Obviously, I didn’t make her walk home without her boots on, so now I just...need to figure out an excuse to give to Ami for why her “present” so suddenly vanished.
lines.zh: 我当然没让她光着脚走回家，所以现在我只……需要想个借口跟 Ami 解释，她的“礼物”怎么突然就不见了。

lines.en: I don’t hear from Kirin again until she gets home- and even then, all I get are exhausted face emojis.
lines.zh: Kirin 到家之前我再没收到她的消息——即便那时，我也只收到几个累瘫的表情。

lines.en: But, despite a rocky start, a rocky ending, and a...normal middle part (?) the evening isn’t a complete disaster.
lines.zh: 不过，尽管开头坎坷、结尾坎坷、中间那段……还算正常（？），这个晚上也不算彻底搞砸。

lines.en: It wasn’t ideal by any means, but I don’t think something like this will be enough to keep her away in the future...
lines.zh: 无论如何都算不上理想，但我觉得这种程度的事，还不至于让她以后都不来了……
